name: backup-radar-mcp
description: Every Backup Radar v3 and v2 endpoint plus a local store that finds the backups nobody is watching.

backup_radar_api_key.title: ScalePad API key (v3)
backup_radar_api_key.description: Optional. ScalePad API key for the v3 commands (health, devices, backups ingest, backups retire, push) and the check, unwatched, scorecard, timeline and stale answers that depend on them. Create one in ScalePad: API tab, New API key (requires an active Administrator user). https://developer.scalepad.com/docs/getting-started

backup_radar_v2_api_key.title: Backup Radar API v2 key
backup_radar_v2_api_key.description: Optional. Backup Radar API key for the read-only v2 commands (backups list, get, results, filters, inactive, retired, overview). Set it if you use the Backup Radar API v2; either key alone powers its own commands.

backup_radar_base_url.title: ScalePad v3 base URL
backup_radar_base_url.description: Optional. The ScalePad Backup Radar v3 API root. Leave blank for the US default https://api.scalepad.com/backup-radar/v3; set https://eu.api.scalepad.com/backup-radar/v3 for EU data residency. The v2 API always uses https://api.backupradar.com.

backup_radar_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
backup_radar_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1, true or yes to hide the backups_ingest and backups_retire tools, the sync, export and workflow_archive mirrors, and the learning-store write tools (teach, teach_pattern, teach_lookup, teach_playbook, playbook_amend, learnings_confirm, learnings_forget, learnings_reject). Read tools still write local state: the local store and the learn journal. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

backup_radar_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
backup_radar_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, nothing new is written to the local store, and sync and workflow archive refuse to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

backup_radar_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
backup_radar_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Leave blank for Claude Desktop.

backup_radar_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
backup_radar_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to ScalePad and Backup Radar. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
